steps: Get a free key at https://aistudio.google.com → Get API key → Create API key (no card or payment).
In Supabase: your project → Edge Functions → Secrets → new secret GEMINI_API_KEY with the key.
Come back and refresh this page: this message will disappear.

no-function.title: The assistant isn’t deployed
no-function.why: The assistant function isn’t on your Supabase project or isn’t responding. Use the built-in fault guide until it’s deployed.
steps: Open a terminal in the project folder: npx supabase login
Then: npx supabase functions deploy assistant --use-api --remote=PROJECT_REF (your project code from the Supabase URL)
Add the free Gemini key in Secrets as GEMINI_API_KEY (full steps in README → AI assistant).

no_charge.title: Not charging
no_charge.causes: Dirty or broken port, bad cable or charger, charging IC, battery.
no_charge.steps:
1. Try a known-good charger and cable.
2. Clean the port with a soft brush.
3. Measure current with a USB meter.
4. No draw: check the charging flex, then the charging IC.
no_charge.warn: Disconnect the battery before any soldering.

no_power.title: No power
no_power.causes: Fully drained battery, power button, board short, stuck software.
no_power.steps:
1. Charge for 30 minutes.
2. Force restart.
3. Power supply and watch the draw.
4. If shorted: check capacitors around the PMIC.

screen.title: Display issue
screen.causes: Broken screen, display flex, backlight IC, touch.
screen.steps:
1. Check for sound or vibration (device is on).
2. Try a known-good screen.
3. Check the connector.
4. Backlight only: check the backlight circuit.

battery.title: Battery
battery.causes: Worn battery, draining apps, board leakage.
battery.steps:
1. Check battery health in settings.
2. Measure draw with the device off.
3. Try a known-good battery.
battery.warn: Remove a swollen battery immediately and carefully.

water.title: Water damage
water.steps:
1. Disconnect the battery at once.
2. Open and clean with isopropyl alcohol and a brush.
3. Dry fully before powering.
4. Inspect corrosion under the microscope.
water.warn: Do not charge until cleaned and dry.

network.title: Network or Wi-Fi
network.steps:
1. Reset network settings.
2. Try another SIM.
3. Check antenna cables.
4. Check the baseband.

audio.title: Audio or mic
audio.causes: Dirty speaker or mic, flex, audio IC.
audio.steps:
1. Clean the mesh.
2. Test call, speaker and recording.
3. Try a known-good part.

camera.title: Camera
camera.causes: Broken lens, camera module, connector, software.
camera.steps:
1. Try both cameras.
2. Clear camera app data.
3. Try a known-good camera.

software.title: Software
software.causes: Incomplete update, broken app, full storage.
software.steps:
1. Safe mode.
2. Free up storage.
3. Update or reflash (after a backup with the customer’s approval).

motion.title: Animated background
motion.running: Motion is on for this device
motion.stopped: Motion is paused on this device

reduced.title: "Reduce motion" is on in your system
reduced.why: Windows (or your system) asks apps to reduce motion, so the app respects it and keeps the background still.
steps: Windows 11: Settings → Accessibility → Visual effects → turn on "Animation effects".
Windows 10: Settings → Ease of Access → Display → turn on "Show animations in Windows".
Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Display → turn off "Reduce motion".
The background starts moving again by itself as soon as you change it, without reloading.

auto.title: Paused automatically due to slowness
auto.why: Motion ran under 50 fps for 2 seconds on the splash or sign-in screen, so the app paused it on this device to stay fast.
steps: On a laptop running on battery: Chrome → Settings → Performance → turn off "Energy saver", or Edge: Settings → System and performance → turn off "Efficiency mode". (The app now tells this apart from real slowness, but a really busy device can still freeze it.)
Windows 10 and 11: set the power mode to "Best performance" (Settings → System → Power & battery on 11, or Power & sleep on 10).
If you're testing with npm run dev, try the production build (steps in README); it's much faster.
If it freezes again, check "Graphics acceleration" below, or open diagnostics with Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M.

software.title: Graphics acceleration is off in the browser
software.why: The browser draws with the CPU only, without the graphics card, which slows motion down.
steps: Chrome: open chrome://settings/system, turn on "Use graphics acceleration when available", then Relaunch.
Edge: open edge://settings/system, turn on "Use graphics acceleration when available", then Restart.

motion.insideNote: Inside the app (after sign-in) the background is still by design, for performance. That’s not a fault. Motion runs on the splash, sign-in, registration and customer tracking screens; the status above is about those.

marketingDue.title: Reminders (with consent)

marketingDue.sub: Customers who agreed to reminders, last serviced 6+ months ago

diag.title: Motion diagnostics

reasons.inside: Inside the app: still by design for performance. Motion runs on the splash and sign-in screens

logoAnim.shineHint: A slight scale-up, then a light sweep passes once

invsum.formula: Inventory profit = sales − their cost − wastage − supplier return difference. Parts used in repairs count toward repair profit.

opening.title: First stocktake
opening.sub: Record what you have today: stock, cash in each cashbox, and debts owed to and by you. Each number becomes a balanced opening entry.
opening.stockHint: Enter each item, its quantity and your unit cost. You can copy the table from Excel and paste it here at once; arrows and Enter move between rows.
opening.cashHint: Enter the money in each cashbox right now. Empty means zero.

opening.name: Name
opening.errParty: Row {{n}}: name and amount are required

partners.title: Partners
partners.sub: Each partner’s share of net profit, capital and current account. Withdrawals are not expenses.
partners.name: Partner name
partners.emptyText: If the shop has partners, add each one with their share of net profit. Shares total up to 100%; the rest stays with the shop.
partners.note: Withdrawals only reduce the partner’s account and are not expenses, so net profit doesn’t change. Reverse any wrong operation from the statement.

partners.depositHint: Capital increases by the type you pick (cash, goods, equipment or earlier) on that date. Not profit.
partners.withdrawHint: Money leaves the cashbox and is deducted from the partner’s account. Not an expense.
partners.distributeHint: Net profit for the period (revenue − expenses) is split by share; the rest stays with the shop. A period can’t be distributed twice.
partners.openingHint: Each partner’s capital at stocktake. It moves from opening capital to the partner’s account.
partners.openingNone: No partners yet. If the shop has partners, add them on the Partners page first.
partners.capHint: What the partner brings in. It’s equity: not profit and not a debt. Leave the amount empty to record it later.
partners.noItems: No items yet. Add items in Inventory first.

goods.title: Goods
goods.hint: Stock increases by qty and cost

old.title: Earlier capital
old.hint: Before using the app; cashboxes untouched

partners.scopeHint: A branch partner's share comes from that branch's profit only

link.unlinked: Unlinked; old statements stay as they are
link.noneCustomer: If this customer also sells to you, link them to the supplier to see the net.
link.noneSupplier: If this supplier also buys from you, link them to the customer to see the net.

link.netSub: Owes as customer − owed as supplier

equity.title: Equity

lists.subStatusesHint: Core statuses are fixed. Add details under each one (e.g. under "Awaiting part": "Ordered" or "On the way"). When the core status changes, the sub-status is cleared.

lists.queued: Saved on this device; it will sync when back online
lists.permTitle: Who can add to and remove from lists

help.dashboard:
Today at a glance: devices received, under repair, late and ready.
Click a card to open its list. Alt+2 opens intake.
help.intake:
1) Type the phone: a registered customer appears.
2) Pick the brand, type the model, then the fault.
3) "Intake suggestions" show this model’s most common faults in your shop and their average cost.
4) Ctrl+Enter saves, then print the sticker and receipt.
help.devices:
All devices. Search by order no., phone or IMEI, and use the status tabs and filters.
Arrow keys and Enter open a device. "Export" gives exactly what’s shown as Excel or PDF.
help.device:
Change status, record cost and payments, print sticker, receipt and invoice, and message the customer on WhatsApp.
Delivery needs a final cost and the balance paid.
help.customers: Customers with device counts and total paid. Open one to see devices, statement and send a message.
help.finance:
Financial position for the period: cash, receivables, payables, inventory and profit. Each card opens details.
Cashboxes are below; each opens its statement. The equation must balance.
help.inventory:
Items with quantity and average cost. Sale, purchase and write-off are at the top.
"Purchase suggestions" show what’s below minimum or selling fast; "Apply" opens a filled purchase invoice.
help.reports: Period reports: technicians, profit per fault type, top models and shortages. Each exports to Excel or PDF.
help.partners: Partners with share, capital and current account. Capital is equity, not debt. Distribute profit once per period.
help.settings: Shop settings: details and logo, payments, technicians, lists, printing, assistant, messages, backup and appearance.
help.work: Your work: devices assigned to you in order. Open one, start the step, record what you did, and finish with the final check.
help.other: Press "?" outside a field for all shortcuts, and Ctrl+K for search and commands.

perm.hint: Roles with your own names, each with a permissions table. The owner always has every permission. Changes apply to staff right away and are recorded in the activity log.

push.summary: You have {{n}} new notifications. Open the app to see them.
push.hint: The same notifications as the bell, delivered to this device even when the app is closed. Everyone enables it on their own device and only gets what their permissions allow.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. On iPhone: add the app to the Home Screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this app in the browser settings. Allow them from the lock icon next to the address and try again.
push.notConfigured: Device notifications are not set up on the server yet. The project owner should follow the "Web Push" steps in the README.
push.disabled: Notifications turned off on this device
push.testSent: Sent. If it does not arrive within a minute, check the device notification settings.
push.windowHint: Outside these hours notifications wait until the window opens. If "From" equals "Until", they arrive all day.

saleInv.title: Sale invoice
saleInv.legacy: Sale recorded before invoice lines: items and quantities from stock, total from the ledger (per-item prices were not recorded).

att.title: Attendance
att.sub: Clock in and out with one tap; the time comes from the server. The owner sees the whole team.
att.emptyTeam: Nobody clocked in during this period
att.needTimes: Enter the clock-in and clock-out times

custImport.title: Import customers from Excel
custImport.hint: Save the sheet from Excel as "CSV UTF-8". First row headers: name and phone (required), area or address (optional).
custImport.partial: {{n}} customer(s) imported; the rest were not saved: {{why}}
custImport.missing: The file is missing a column: {{cols}}

vat.title: VAT
vat.hint: If the shop is VAT-registered: prices stay tax-inclusive, and the app separates the tax in the books and invoices. Changes apply to sales and deliveries from now on; past records stay as they were.
vat.due: VAT due to the tax authority
vat.payHint: The amount leaves the cashbox and reduces the VAT due.
